'''Sportverein Darmstadt 1898 e.V.''', commonly known as '''Darmstadt 98''' ({{IPA|de|ˌdaʁmʃtat ʔaxtʔʊntˈnɔɪ̯nt͡sɪç|-|De-Darmstadt 98.ogg}}), is a [[Football in Germany|German professional association football club]] based in [[Darmstadt]], [[Hesse]]. The club was founded on 22 May 1898 as FC Olympia Darmstadt. Early in 1919, the association was briefly known as ''Rasen-Sportverein Olympia'' before merging with Darmstädter Sport Club 1905 on 11 November that year to become Sportverein Darmstadt 98. Merger partner SC was the product of a 1905 union between Viktoria 1900 Darmstadt and Germania 1903 Darmstadt. The footballers are today part of a sports club which also offers its over 13,500 members<ref>{{cite web |date= |title=Wir Lilien. Sind der Verein. |url=https://wirlilien.de/ |access-date=29 July 2023 |website=WIR LILIEN |publisher=SV Darmstadt 98 |language=de |archive-date=30 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230930035431/https://wirlilien.de/ |url-status=live }}</ref> [[basketball]], [[hiking]], [[futsal]], [[judo]], and [[table tennis]].

The football department competed in the [[Bundesliga]] for the 2015–16 and 2016–17 seasons after a 33-year run in lower leagues. Darmstadt 98 were promoted again to the Bundesliga in 2023; however, they did not avoid relegation the following season."}}
